name: rpa-operations-center
description: Painel corporativo para monitoramento, documentacao e gestao de robos RPA (Automation Anywhere).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
